units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 53a:5">B. Bath. 53ᵃ</cite> <he>פרץ פ׳ וכ׳</he> if he widened the opening in the fence to go in and out by it.

<cite ref="Sukkah 26a:6">Succ. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>פ׳ קוראה לגנב</he> a breach (occasion) invites the thief. Tanḥ. Vayishl. 5 <he>אין ניתנין פ׳ לפני הכשר וכ׳</he> we must not leave an opening (offer a temptation) to an honest man, how much less to a thief.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 3:4:2">Y. Gitt. III, 45ᵃ</cite> <he>היתה שם פ׳ אחת וכ׳</he> if there was a single gap (for the besieged to escape), it saves all (justifies the presumption that they are alive).

Peah VII, 1 בצד פ׳ (Y. ed. הפרוצה) by the gap (entrance) in the fence; a. fr.—Trnsf. inroad, calamity. Tanḥ. Bal. 13 יש פ׳ גדולה מזו is there a greater calamity than this (the death of Moses)? Yalk. Ps. 888 (ref. to פרץ, Ps. CXLIV, 14) פ׳ של פורענות the calamity of divine visitation (pestilence, with ref. to Ps. CVI, 29 ותפרץ); פ׳ של גלות the calamity of exile; Ruth R. introd. פ׳ של מגפה; פֶּרֶץ של גלות.

Lev. R. s. 34, end (ref. to Is. LVIII, 12) הפ׳ הזאת עלי היה לגודרה וכ׳ the Lord says, it was for me to repair that breach (to remedy the evil of poverty), and thou rosest to repair it (by charity); a. fr.—2) lawlessness, licentiousness, demoralization.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 26:5">Gen. R. s. 26</cite> <he>כל פ׳ שאינה … אינה פ׳</he> demoralization which does not proceed from the leaders, is no real demoralization; a. e.—Pl. <he>פְּרָצוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Middot 2:3">Midd. II, 3</cite> <he>שלש עשרה פ׳ היו בו שפרצום וכ׳</he> there were thirteen breaches in the Temple palisades (<cite ref="O00417"><he>סוֹרֶג</he></cite>) made by the Greek kings; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 6:2:2">Y. Shek. VI, 50ᵃ</cite> top.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 91b:12">B. Bath. 91ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <he>גדרה</he>, <cite ref="I Chronicles 4:23">I Chr. IV, 23</cite>) <he>זו סנהדרין שגדרו פִרְצוֹתֵיהֶן וכ׳</he> this refers to the Sanhedrin that healed the breaches of Israel.
Yalk. Ez. 352; Ruth R. introd. שאלו עליתם בפ׳ וכ׳ if you had stood in the breaches as Moses did &c.; a. fr.—[Num. R. s. 20 שיש פרצים, v. פָּרַץ.]—3) sect.—Pl. as ab.
<cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 5:2">Ab. d’R. N. ch. V</cite> <he>ונפרצו מהם שתי פ׳</he> and two sects proceeded from them.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 73:11">Gen. R. s. 73</cite>, a. e., v. <cite ref="Q01968"><he>פָּרַץ</he></cite>.
